_note: Ferrite-rod medium-wave coil with a tap and a coupling winding. 5-terminal, one row: a, tap, b (main winding, tap at a fraction of its turns from a) and c1, c2 (the coupling winding). Engine (bw-board ferrite_coil): henrys (a-b), tap fraction, couplingRatio (coupling turns / main), k (tap coupling), couplingK, q (unloaded Q). Tunes the medium-wave band with the tuning_cap across a-b.
